guard/30041.htm.text: Guard Arnold: Do you see that grand structure across the bridge? That is the renowned Cedric's Training Hall, famous for producing many great fighters. It was erected by Sir Cedric , Aden's finest paladin and the right hand of King Raoul.

links.text: See the Lord and get the tax rate information

guard/30041-1.htm.text: Guard Arnold: During Aden's unification war, Sir Cedric served King Raoul and performed meritorious deeds on the battlefield. He lived his entire life true to the spirit of chivalry and the will of Einhasad. He is the model for all young fighters of the kingdom, and a living legend. When unificatio…

Q00104_SpiritOfMirrors/30043-01.html.text: Guard Johnstone: A few days ago, while patrolling the western parts of the School of Wizardry , I encountered a werewolf near a bridge . I drew my bow and chased after him, but all of a sudden, his body started to waver, and he turned into a great toad! Do you think there are some werewolves that k…

Q00104_SpiritOfMirrors/30045-01.html.text: Guard Kenyos: Last night, while patrolling the west coast of the island , I saw an Orc transforming into a werewolf! I thought I may have been seeing things, because I was so tired, but I asked the other guards and they all say that they saw the same thing!

Q00153_DeliverGoods/30041-01.htm.text: Guard Arnold: Following the war with Gracia, our king issued a trade embargo, and trade with Gracia was stopped altogether. Q00153_DeliverGoods/30041-00.htm.text: Guard Arnold: These days, no trade ships bearing the flag of Gracia sail into the dock. That's because all trade with Gracia has been halted since the war. It was quite a sight to see the great trade ships slowly sail into the harbor with their horns sounding, but I guess we won't be seeing any of …

Q00153_DeliverGoods/30041-03.html.text: Sentry Arnold: You still haven't made the deliveries? Please do so immediately and bring me back the receipts! The Heavy Wooden Box goes to Merchant Jackson at the Weapons Shop, the Fabrics go to Merchant Silvia at the General Store, and the Clay Pot goes to Warehouse Keeper Rant.

Q00153_DeliverGoods/30041-04.html.text: Guard Arnold: Have you finished all your deliveries? Thank you. As promised, here is your pay. If you ever get the chance, let's have a drink sometime. It's not a bad experience to sit on the shore and tip back a drink, while watching the night sea.
